name: Conservation Teen Scientist
what_you_do: Train to teach guests about zoo animals. Practice public speaking. Help with zoo jobs like making animal meals and the giraffe feeding platform.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 18 entering or currently in high school. The page describes a yearly commitment.
duration: Yearly: 15 days in summer plus 2 days a month in the school year
deadline_text: Applications are closed. They reopen March 2, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the form opens again on March 2, 2027. A reference form is required. Questions: volunteer@zoomiami.org.
notes: The page says a reference form is required. Questions: volunteer@zoomiami.org.
